walkthroughs.body_html:
A feral child grows up without normal human contact.

Sad cases through history show: such children struggle with language, empathy and rules.

In 1970 Los Angeles, 'Genie' was found, aged 13, after years locked alone.

She could barely speak. Despite teaching, she never fully caught up — suggesting a critical period for language.

Sociologists conclude:

  • Humans are made, not just born.
  • Socialisation is essential.
  • Some skills must be learned early.

Family and community truly shape us. ❤️
